index.title: CODE ANYTHING · Software architecture and engineering consultancy
index.description: CODE ANYTHING is a young engineering consultancy from Zagreb. Software architecture, project rescue, security, payments and systems at scale, embedded and IoT. Remote across the EU and DACH, startups first.
index.hero_title: An engineering consultancy for systems that cannot afford to fail quietly.
index.lede: CODE ANYTHING is a young, independent consultancy from Zagreb. I design, build and maintain software across the whole stack: the interfaces people rely on, backends built to scale, edge devices and firmware. The company is new. The engineering behind it is not.
index.aim_title: What I Set Out to Do
aim: I am starting deliberately small: a few clients at a time, each one given full attention. Startups come first. They need someone who can turn an idea into a specification, an architecture and a first working product without wasting their runway.

I also take the problems others avoid: the integration everyone has declared impossible, the bug that only appears under load, the device in the field that nobody can reach. If something in your system is failing, it is failing for a reason. My job is to find that reason and remove it.

tenets.title: Find the cause, not the symptom.
tenets.text: A computer is a deterministic machine. Every fault has a reason, and that reason can be found, explained and removed for good.

tenets.title: Choose the right tool.
tenets.text: There is always a better tool for the job, even when it is not the one the team already knows. I am not tied to any language or framework.

tenets.title: Build what is needed.
tenets.text: Designs that meet today's requirements and leave room for tomorrow's, without paying for complexity nobody asked for.

tenets.title: Say it plainly.
tenets.text: Honest scope, honest estimates, and an honest answer when I am not the right fit.

founder.title: Ana Vuletić · Founder of CODE ANYTHING · Software architect
founder.description: Ana Vuletić founded CODE ANYTHING. A software architect working across web platforms, payments, security, industrial protocols and embedded devices.
profile: I'm Ana, the founder of CODE ANYTHING. My work has never stayed in one layer of the stack. I have built web platforms and the services behind them, integrated payment providers and terminals, run fleets of devices in the field, connected PLCs, HMIs and EV chargers, and written firmware for STM32 microcontrollers.

That range is the point. Most failures happen between layers: between the device and the server, between one service and the next. I am at my best where nobody else wants to look, finding out why something happens and making sure it stops.

I don't belong to one language or framework. C, C++, Java, Python and TypeScript are my working languages, and I keep studying more, because knowing how a tool works underneath is how you choose the right one.
founder.principle_tool: There's always a better tool for the job.
founder.principle_reason: Everything happens for a reason on a computer. It's a dumb, deterministic machine, not a human to reason with.
